prompt: Route A is 240 miles with a $6 toll. Route B is 160 miles with an $18 toll. Your car travels 40 miles on one gallon of fuel, and fuel costs $4 per gallon. Which route costs less in total (fuel plus toll), and by how much?
explanation: Route A fuel: 240 / 40 = 6 gallons, at 6 x $4 = $24, plus the $6 toll = $30. Route B fuel: 160 / 40 = 4 gallons, at 4 x $4 = $16, plus the $18 toll = $34. Difference: $34 - $30 = $4, so Route A is cheaper even though it is longer. Comparing fuel alone gives an $8 gap and misses the tolls.
